## Summary of PR/Issue
- PR #256 fixes issue #255 by changing explicit non-issue `/implement` metadata generation from `approve-reads` to `approve-all`.
- The bug was that the metadata prompt tried to run `gh pr view` inside the agent runtime, which still required interactive approval under `approve-reads` and failed in GitHub Actions.
- The linked #232/#244 context confirms this metadata path should generate context-derived tracking issue titles, and the later requester instruction explicitly chose the simpler `approve-all` fix over deterministic prefetch.
- The PR also updates the focused workflow-envelope test to lock the intended permission mode.

## Review
The synthesized reviews support shipping this PR. Claude noted optional test-depth and prompt-guardrail improvements, while Codex and rubrics review found the current narrow change consistent with the latest explicit request.
